title: mri_relabel_nonwm_hypos
description: Relabels non-WM hypointensities based on proximity to a nearby label.

inputseg.description: Input segmentation file with non-wm-hypos labeled as 80, 81, or 82.
inputseg.title: Input Segmentation

outputseg.description: Output segmentation file with non-wm-hypos relabeled.
outputseg.title: Output Segmentation

segments.description: Label hypos adjacent to specified segment as a new segment (can be used multiple times).
segments.title: Segments

checkopts.description: Don't run anything, just check options and exit.
checkopts.title: Check Options Flag
